name: crawl-content
description: Use to crawl Chinese social media (B站/小红书/抖音/微博/快手/知乎) for content + comments via MediaCrawler, optionally chain to /wechat-article (writes 4000-char body) → export as local docx report at `$CRAWL_WORKDIR/{主题}-{YYYYMMDD}.docx`. Supports multi-platform parallel crawling — natural-language input is auto-split into jobs (e.g. 「全网扫 LABUBU」→ xhs+dy+wb+bili in parallel). Trigger on /crawl-content <平台> <
